notes.title: New (spooky) update!
notes.notes:
Hi breakfast lovers!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28814161/1df26db328ddc9b8a33a6244a065532a9d19019c.png

In order to celebrate the Steam Halloween Sales, we're updating Breaking Fast with some nice spooky content... But we don't want to spoil it, so you'd better get it and see it for yourself! :P

In addition, we have fixed some bugs and stability issues to improve the gameplay experience.

So what are you waiting for? Go play it and don't get scared!

The Breaking Fast Team

notes.title: New Update: Steam Cloud and IA improvements
notes.notes:
Hi breakfast lovers!

After hearing your feedback, we've updated Breaking Fast in order to include, among others, the following new features:

- Cloud Save integration so that you can have your progress on any other PC. Now you can take your best breakfast wherever you want!

- Revised and improved Artificial Intelligence to make the CPU players more fair and fun than they are now. Nonetheless, you'll still have to dodge lots of punches and superattacks!

- Stability fixes to prevent some infrequent crashes.

- Localization fixes in several languages.

We have great plans to continue improving the game, and we're always eager to hear your thoughts, so let us know what you think and what you'd improve! 

Enjoy your food!

Breaking Fast Team

notes.title: New patch to address community feedback
notes.notes:
Hello Breaking Fast community!

Thank you for all your videos, comments, and screenshots since the release of Breaking Fast - we really value them! 

We've been watching carefully all your videos and taking notes about your suggestions, so we made a few changes in this first patch to address some of the issues raised.


    New sound bars have been added for both the sound effects and the background music, so you can know adjust them to the volume you like, specially useful for all the youtubers out there!
    Fix online game creation occasionally failing to register the game server if you were searching for a game seconds before trying to create a new room.


We constantly keep an eye on the Breaking Fast community to make sure you get the best experience, so if you have any other suggestions or ideas, let us know in the forums!


The Breaking Fast Team

notes.title: Release date!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We've just officially set the official release date of Breaking Fast: June, the 8th. Yes, less than a month to enjoy the most absurdly fun and delicious game ever!

So save your appetite and spread the word!

The Breaking Fast Team
